CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2588 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb. Bus nonce: e245625fcfc35a83b4c0685318d070df. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb` or `Fix review: blocked 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e245625fcfc35a83b4c0685318d070df`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2588 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2588-e245625f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2588 at head 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at that head, and use the finder's harness the group brief names (roster: origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, read with jq), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.

First review of this head. This is the roster PR (PR-B, the sole change is dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, plus carry files if any). The head carries roster tip 2ce05426. Check that EVERY group added since the last review passes brief_lint and validates against the roster schema: R10-FLY-BUDGET-LEAF, R10-FLY-STAMP-CHECK-NOTES, R10-FLY-MANDATE-REVOKE-GUARD, the R10-FLOW-JIDOKA sentence citing #2528, and the P22 carry on R10-FLOW-BODY-ONLY; then the earlier groups (23 R10-FLOW-*, the fly-ins, R10-ROUND-PLAYBOOK) and the body's group counts (re-count them with jq). Run brief_lint.mjs and the roster schema validator yourself and report their output; a group with a literal metric or a count the tree answers is an error. Every carry the body or roster adds must resolve to a live group.

Required:
- Run the mutation proof, the finder's harness at both ends and a null control for every quantified claim yourself; CI cannot produce them.
- Re-measure every figure in the PR body at this head and report each as re-derived or not re-derivable.
- Standing rule 19: run carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over the body and report 0 unrouted; every Carry in your own verdict must be routed too.
- ## Red checks: read the check-runs API per commit at this head. nightly-status grades main, not this PR unless the diff reaches what it reads; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT.
- Merge-tree: judge the combined result with git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 922640dcd6ca515040d18a12a0a4e74aaa5eb8fb (clean required); do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head.
- Confirm roles/ on main is unchanged since the merge base, else re-read the contract.
- Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt). Include the line bus-nonce: e245625fcfc35a83b4c0685318d070df in VERDICT.md.
